The [JSON Pointer syntax](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6901) that indicates the entry to update, in `/values/#` format, where `#` is the entry ID. The first record begins at the `0` value.

The [JSON Pointer syntax](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6901) that indicates the entry to update, in `/values/#/{value}` format, where:
- `#` — The entry ID. The first record begins at the `0` value.
- `{value}` — The variable property to update. Accepts `key`, `value`, `type`, and `enable`.
